59181565.s: Winter at Tantora returns, the Kingdom's first music and arts festival, with a new look and design over six weeks. The festival opens with a mesmerizing candlelit orchestra at Hegra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, marking the start of AlUla's festival season.
59181565.b:
Winter at Tantora returns, the Kingdom's first music and arts festival, with a new look and design over six weeks. The festival opens with a mesmerizing candlelit orchestra at Hegra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, marking the start of AlUla's festival season.

The equestrian program includes the much-anticipated Fashion Show, a showcase of riders' attire at Ekmah, the return of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Endurance Cup (the Riders' Gathering), the AlUla Desert Polo Championship, and the AlUla Citrus Festival. The Harrat Uwayrid viewpoint, linked to the neighbouring Back to Black restaurant, offers stunning sunrise and sunset views over AlUla from the top of Harrat Uwayrid. Cultural and archaeology workshops are held at heritage sites, and interactive shows return to AlUla Old Town and AlUla Oasis. Winter at Tantora runs from 21 December to 12 February.

59182583.s: From February 2021, the AlUla Arts Festival hosts art exhibitions and a range of gatherings featuring many artistic talents, celebrating AlUla's rich heritage as a historic hub and meeting point for cultural exchange. The award-winning Maraya hall hosts the "Arts of Our Time" exhibition, presenting the latest contemporary works by prominent artists from the Kingdom. Al Jadidah will be a lively centre for art activity and performances, with the open-air Al Hosh Cinema screening films by local Saudi filmmakers, along with curated art experiences inspired by the culture and heritage of the oasis and other places across the governorate.

59182628.s: AlUla's many striking geological landscapes, from volcanic plains to ancient heritage sites, are best seen from the air during the AlUla Skies festival.
59182628.b:
AlUla's many striking geological landscapes, from volcanic plains to ancient heritage sites, are best seen from the air during the AlUla Skies festival.

The new Constellations sound-and-light show adds to the stargazing experience in AlUla, while "Symphony Under the Stars" lets visitors enjoy a stunning musical performance beneath millions of twinkling stars. All of this is available to book from 27 February to 12 March.

Building on its history as a place of rest and recreation, the AlUla Cultural Oasis will become a destination for calm and relaxation from this coming December. The "Garden of Moments" activity offers an amazing experience in an environment that responds to space, light and sound, with installations that spark the imagination.

59182751.s: As part of the AlUla Wellness Festival in March 2022, the Sensory Retreat brand will offer a complete range of mind, body and spirit experiences led by yoga and meditation practitioners.

As part of the AlUla Wellness Festival in March 2022, the Sensory Retreat brand will offer a complete range of mind, body and spirit experiences led by yoga and meditation practitioners.

For more energetic activities, Eco Trail returns to AlUla with fitness sessions in AlUla Oasis, offering a daily dose of endorphins through group workouts.

The "Sand-Immersed Sessions" around Elephant Rock return this year, with new adventure experiences.

60168027.b:
The World Marketing Summit was launched in 2010 by Dr. Philip Kotler, the father of modern marketing. The WMS has been held in various countries across Europe, America and Asia over the past ten years, with its audience growing every year and attracting relevant topics and first-class speakers.

In response to the 2020 global health crisis, which forced many countries into lockdown, the World Marketing Summit moved to a virtual platform and was renamed the eWorld Marketing Summit, or eWMS.

The 2021 eWMS conference will attract more than 150,000 participants from over 110 countries and more than 100 speakers from around the world on 6 and 7 November.

To register: https://bit.ly/3zIRwC4

Once registered, you will receive:

A certificate of attendance signed by Philip Kotler

One month of LOD (Learning on Demand)

The book Big Bang Marketing

About the event

As part of our effort to provide the best fun and creative environment for our children, we share in their preparations for the new school year through the Back to Riyadh Festival. 66949081.b:
Discover the "Azimuth 2022" event

A varied music festival that brings East and West together for 3 days, amid the mystery of stunning natural scenery, in a historic site that reflects AlUla's standing as a meeting point of civilisations and cultural exchange. The finest music, tastiest food, and best artistic and cultural performances await guests of "Azimuth 2022", with eye-catching views across the desert valleys and enchanting colours painted by the sun in the sky at sunrise and sunset. This year the event is held in the same valley that hosted the Desert X AlUla 2022 exhibition, so our guests can see the remaining large-scale artworks that took part in the exhibition this year.

Don't miss the chance to celebrate with us at this special music festival. Subscribe below or follow us on our social media pages to be the first to hear the latest event news and when tickets go on sale.

Get to know the "Azimuth 2020" event

Get to know the "Azimuth 2020" event

Azimuth launched for the first time in 2020 as a music project aiming to define our relationship with the sun and its effect on creativity, regardless of a person's identity or where they live. Azimuth 2020 drew its idea from "Tantora", the sundial in AlUla Old Town, bringing together international and local artists of the twenty-first century on AlUla's land to celebrate sunrise and sunset with them.

"Azimuth 2022" event

Arts

This year the event is held in the same valley that hosted the Desert X AlUla 2022 exhibition, so festival guests can see the remaining large-scale artworks created by international and local artists during the exhibition this year.

Food and drink

Rest areas and services

An event organised by the Saudi Falcons Club at its headquarters in Malham, north of Riyadh, from 25 August to 3 September. It is classed as the largest exhibition of its kind in the Kingdom and the world, and the first Saudi platform for acquiring weapons of all kinds.

67380260.t: Guy Manoukian and Ara Malikian Live at Maraya
67380260.s: Guy Manoukian and Ara Malikian live at Maraya
67380260.b:
Guy Manoukian and Ara Malikian live at Maraya

Guy Manoukian is a Lebanese-Armenian musician, composer and pianist with a distinctive musical style that has influenced the local and international music scene over the past thirty years. He has gained wide international fame and collaborated with leading artists in the United States. He excels at blending Eastern rhythms with contemporary musical techniques, and his concerts have sold out at major venues in London, Singapore, Dubai, Monaco, Los Angeles and many more.

Ara Malikian is a Spanish violinist of Lebanese and Armenian origin. In 2015 he released the album "15" to celebrate 15 years of his life in Spain, and the tour that followed the release was a great success, reaching an audience of 175,000 people over more than 150 concerts. His next album, "The Incredible History of the Violin", gained wide international fame, and he has performed on the stages of the world's most important theatres.

68706768.b:
Explore the JAX District, one of the most prominent creative areas in Riyadh.

Discover the JAX District in Diriyah, transformed from a forgotten industrial area into one of the most important creative destinations packed with artworks, and an essential destination for talents and artists to exchange ideas in art studios. JAX houses contemporary and international art galleries.

The JAX District is not just a space but a world that brings all art together, the result of the creativity of artists whose work has drawn unforgettable aesthetic landmarks. At JAX we open the doors to art spaces, studios and enriching workshops.

Join us and share the journey.

Live tours full of wonder and boundless imagination, in artworks and contrasting experiences that raise questions about integration. The tours take visitors among the works of David Spriggs, which create an interesting dialogue between his two large installations exploring darkness and transparency versus perception and understanding. We also see the contrast of the calm immersion in sea waves in the work of teamLab after the experience of Rashed Al Shashai's installation, which evokes feelings of confusion and curiosity.

The hub's works include: Endless Since 83, by Mohammed Hammad - Sound of Listening, by Zahra Bundakji - 100 Million, by Rashed Al Shashai - Everything, by Nohlab - Quartzscapes, by Philippe Rockà - Waves of Light, by teamLab - Nur Mandala, by Joanna Grounder - The Intangible Form, by Shuhei Fujimoto - Black and White Formations, by David Spriggs

Hub 5 is home to some wonderful artworks. These installations will leave you amazed, delighted and full of energy, and as you wander the wide spaces you will see innovative and inspiring 3D and 4D shows by some of the world's leading artists.

Join us at this hub to see "Nests in Riyadh" by Tadashi Kawamata, which blends the organic and rustic elements of nature with contemporary materials and modern city civilisation; Sabine Weiss, whose beautiful images from the past shine on the walls of this futuristic area; and Douglas Gordon, who expresses the concept of time and the power of the speed of light in a series of glowing numbers. These neon numbers complete the letters of Joël Andrianomearisoa's poem about place and time: "On an endless horizon, a nostalgia for the future to keep the present alive".

Join us at the King Abdullah Financial District, Hub 5, and make this unique experience part of your world of light.

69338313.s: The Al-Ahsa Oasis Festival is your chance to visit the most important heritage sites in Al-Ahsa Governorate, to learn about the region's heritage and authenticity, and immerse yourself in its heritage, cultural and entertainment events for a unique experience that blends civilisation and heritage like no other.
69338313.b:
The Al-Ahsa Oasis Festival is your chance to visit the most important heritage sites in Al-Ahsa Governorate, to learn about the region's heritage and authenticity, and immerse yourself in its heritage, cultural and entertainment events for a unique experience that blends civilisation and heritage like no other.

At Ain Najm you can enjoy watching the beauty of Arabian horses, stroll among the craftspeople's corners and watch folklore performances of folk dances that reflect a culture stretching back hundreds of ages.

Muhairis Palace offers a mix of cultural and traditional events. At the Saudi National Team exhibition you relive the best football memories, and on giant screens you can watch some of the Saudi national team's World Cup matches in an atmosphere full of excitement. The craftspeople's market lets you see handicraft demonstrations, along with musical performances to delight the ears, and your experience is completed by tasting the best local food from upscale restaurants.

At Bait Al Bay'ah you can stroll through several exhibitions, including Saudi coffee, where you learn how coffee is prepared and grown. At the Saudi House exhibition you discover the way of life in the past, and hear the story of the people of Al-Ahsa pledging allegiance to King Abdulaziz, narrated by Dr. Abdullatif Al Mulla in an engaging and enjoyable style.

The Amiriyah School will enrich your culture as you walk around and learn how traditional products such as the Hasawi bisht are made, and heritage arts such as plaster carvings, through art exhibitions and daily educational workshops. You can also tour the education exhibition, watch musical performances, and enjoy the best food from upscale local restaurants.

Souq Al Qaisariyah is where different cultures meet, letting you discover and savour authentic traditional foods. During your visit you will join in games and folk dances such as the Ardah, the Samri and the Mujailisi, in a wonderful family atmosphere.

70292026.s: You will discover treasures of heritage in front of the crossing of civilisations and meeting point of cultures, here at the historic port of Uqair, the first economic gateway of the Arabian Peninsula. You will enjoy a unique experience through a series of special events and activities, such as live displays of ancient trading activities, sculpting of heritage figures, Al-Ahsa decorative patterns on sand, and fishing, and you will hear sailors' chants and heritage art performances.
70292026.b:
You will discover treasures of heritage in front of the crossing of civilisations and meeting point of cultures, here at the historic port of Uqair, the first economic gateway of the Arabian Peninsula. You will enjoy a unique experience through a series of special events and activities, such as live displays of ancient trading activities, sculpting of heritage figures, Al-Ahsa decorative patterns on sand, and fishing, and you will hear sailors' chants and heritage art performances.

At the "Uqair Port Exhibition" you will learn about the beautiful past through a wide range of photos reflecting Uqair Port's commercial, economic and cultural importance. At the "Fishermen's Dock" you will discover your fishing skills through a complete experience with all the necessary equipment under the guidance of fishermen. At the "Sailors' Dock" you will watch heritage art performances with simple words and a rhythm in harmony with the waves. From there you move on to the early days of progress and old means of transport at the classic car exhibition, where you can see classic cars in attractive colours and take your best photos next to them. As you pass through the "Caravan Station" you will see camels and how they carried trade goods. You will learn about maritime handicrafts from the most skilled craftspeople in "Uqair Souq", and your children will make sand moulds engraved with Al-Ahsa decorative patterns to learn about one of their ancestors' heritage arts in a creative, innovative way, in addition to the Little Explorer activity, which fosters children's love of research and discovery. Finally, your cultural experience is completed at "Al Farda Restaurant and the port's restaurants", tasting the finest seafood and traditional dishes in the traditional way, in folk seating areas with a charming view of the shore of Uqair Port.

70875286.b:
The moment of truth is fast approaching as we witness the bout everyone has been waiting for on Saudi soil, where the professional boxers Jake Paul of the United States and Tommy Fury of Britain face each other live in the Diriyah ring on 26 February.

This eagerly awaited bout, dubbed "The Truth Fight", is the latest and most anticipated sporting showdown among young Saudis, as neither boxer has ever lost a fight.

Having gained international fame and popularity early on as an actor and social media influencer, Jake Paul (with a record of 6 wins and no defeats, 4 of them by knockout) has achieved amazing success in professional boxing. The American enters this fight with great confidence after knocking out UFC legend Anderson Silva in the last round in October, and aims to deliver the best performance of his career under the lights in Diriyah.

The American Jake Paul (with a record of 6 wins and no defeats, 4 of them by knockout) has achieved great success in professional boxing. He is a global phenomenon and one of the best-known and most successful sports stars, and has promised his fans an amazing performance in the ring in Diriyah.

On the other side stands the British boxer Tommy Fury, half-brother of WBC heavyweight champion Tyson Fury, who also has an amazing record (8 wins and no defeats, 4 of them by knockout). Fury has also set distinctive records so far, and has strong fan support thanks to his family's long history in boxing and his great popularity as a figure known from reality TV in the United Kingdom. Fury aims to add to his tally of wins, especially as excitement and anticipation have grown since the fight was postponed twice.

Gates open at: 6:00 PM

71571983.t: World Theatre Day Celebration - Play "The Stranger and the Captain"
71571983.s: On 27 March every year the world celebrates World Theatre Day, which was adopted by the International Theatre Institute and first celebrated on 27 March 1962, the date of the launch of the "Theatre of Nations" season in Paris.
71571983.b:
On 27 March every year the world celebrates World Theatre Day, which was adopted by the International Theatre Institute and first celebrated on 27 March 1962, the date of the launch of the "Theatre of Nations" season in Paris.

This year the Theatre and Performing Arts Commission celebrates the occasion with you and presents the play "The Stranger and the Captain".

About the play:

The play follows the young man Badr, who goes looking for medicine to treat his sick mother and finds himself in the middle of a military barracks at the start of a war he has no idea about. The story continues between Badr, "the stranger", and the captain, forming a series of exciting scenes.

72278340.s: The idea of the improv games show is a fun comedy night, different from the usual, with two teams of professional improv actors. 72278340.b:
The idea of the improv games show is a fun comedy night, different from the usual, with two teams of professional improv actors. The show has 6 different segments, and the audience points to the segment they want to see, after which the two teams start coordinating how it unfolds in a professional and funny way.

The audience will feel excitement and enthusiasm during this delightful show, as the actors play a different role in each segment and face any challenges that may arise during the performance. The audience will take part in these exciting contests and play a decisive role in determining the fate of each segment.

This will be an interesting experience for anyone looking for a fun, different experience, as the audience will enjoy laughing and interacting with the actors and feel part of the performance. So if you want to spend a night full of laughter and excitement, don't miss the chance to attend the improv games shows.

Welcome to VIZION by Cirque du Soleil, a show created exclusively for Saudi Arabia as part of the Jeddah Events Calendar 2023.

When we are young, we want to live a boundless, worldwide experience, where every passing day feels like an adventure, but in the end the day ends and we cannot dream because we are so busy.

We invite you to revive your childhood and your dreams by attending VIZION by Cirque du Soleil, an enchanting show featuring storytelling through colourful characters and exclusive performing and acrobatic arts, so that we relive our childhood memories and dream without limits.

74348328.t: Hijra Exhibition: In the Footsteps of the Prophet (peace be upon him)
74348328.s: The exhibition "Hijra: In the Footsteps of the Prophet (peace be upon him)" opens at the Saudi National Museum, its second stop after the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), to highlight the journey that began more than fourteen hundred years ago.
74348328.b:
The exhibition "Hijra: In the Footsteps of the Prophet (peace be upon him)" opens at the Saudi National Museum, its second stop after the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), to highlight the journey that began more than fourteen hundred years ago.

Visitors to the Hijra exhibition move between several sections rich in history, archaeology and documentaries, in a narrative sequence of the events of the Hijra, from the pre-Islamic period through the eight days of the journey with its conditions and events, to reaching Madinah. This journey marks a turning point that changed the course of the world and laid the foundations of Islamic history, establishing a new human civilisation whose sun rose with the Prophet's (peace be upon him) migration from Makkah to Yathrib.

The exhibition "Hijra: In the Footsteps of the Prophet (peace be upon him)" is held through a cultural partnership between the Saudi National Museum and the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), as part of steps to strengthen cultural cooperation and integration and reinforce the historical and civilisational dimension of the Kingdom.

Note:

Admission closes one hour before the exhibition closes.

Registration can be done manually at reception if the allotted number of tickets runs out.

75250495.s: "A brief audio-visual journey into Saudi popular music. The Fana Phone exhibition reveals a hidden treasure of valuable and unique items collected by the Saudi artist Dr. Saad Al Huwaidi over the past decade, some dating back to the 1950s and some extending to the present day. It takes us through its halls, in tune with Saudi folk music and Saudi song, to explore the emergence of this musical genre in the Kingdom and the reasons for its continued popularity. The exhibition speaks to its visitors through five selected sections that look at the exhibits through different lenses. The first section, "From Traditional Performance Music to Popular Music", presents the earliest manifestations of Saudi music and its transformations; the second section, "Transformation from Within", deals with changes in the music scene; the third section, "Going Global", takes us on a tour of experiences that enriched the regional and global music scene, while the fourth section, "Popular Music in Sound and Image", touches on the influence of the print press and its pioneering role in promoting music events. Finally, the fifth section, "Voices from the Present", takes us to the reality of music in the contemporary era. The Fana Phone exhibition invites its visitors to reflect on the development of traditional Saudi performance music through history and to learn about its role in building the contemporary cultural scene."

75499027.t: Imru' Al-Qais, the Poet of Love Festival
75499027.s: As part of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts to strengthen poetic culture,
75499027.b:
As part of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts to strengthen poetic culture,

and in light of designating 2023 as the Year of Arabic Poetry, the cultural festival of the love poet

Imru' Al-Qais will be held in the heart of the capital, Riyadh.

The festival is distinguished by an ambitious vision that focuses on introducing one of the icons of Arabic poetry and highlighting

his creative works and rich life.

Visitors will set out on a unique cultural journey to learn about the legacy of the poet Imru' Al-Qais ibn Hujr, nicknamed the "Prince of Poets" and known as one of the brightest poets of the pre-Islamic era, who had a great influence on the course of Arab creativity and the founding of Arab culture from the earliest times.

The festival will offer a varied bouquet of rich cultural events, including a children's corner, the poet's exhibition,

a visual documentation corner, musical performances, the poet's theatre, as well as the market that takes visitors back

to the atmosphere of the ancient times in which the poet lived.

75706409.t: The Phantom of the Opera in Riyadh
75706409.s: Gaston Leroux's The Phantom of the Opera is set in the nineteenth century and tells of a musical genius of a ghost who lives in the depths of the opera house and haunts the young Christine to be his pupil, until he falls in love with her, without realising Christine's feelings for Raoul, so jealousy, madness and passion collide!
75706409.b:
Gaston Leroux's The Phantom of the Opera is set in the nineteenth century and tells of a musical genius of a ghost who lives in the depths of the opera house and haunts the young Christine to be his pupil, until he falls in love with her, without realising Christine's feelings for Raoul, so jealousy, madness and passion collide!

Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical has won more than 70 major theatre awards and amazed the world with more than 13,900 performances on Broadway.

The world's most popular play, seen by more than 160 million people since its debut in London's West End in 1986, celebrates 37 years in October.

The Royal Commission for Riyadh City and Broadway Entertainment Group present the latest production in Riyadh with a cast and a 100-piece orchestra to bring an amazing show to life!

Doors open at 7:00 PM and the show starts at exactly 7:30 PM. We hope you will arrive at the venue 30 minutes before the show starts.

Weekdays: 7:30 PM

The show lasts two and a half hours

76814138.s: Iltiqa (Meeting) is an exceptional art experience organised by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts, hosting South Korea, to create shared artistic spaces and make a meeting point between traditional arts.

Iltiqa (Meeting) is an exceptional art experience organised by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts, hosting South Korea, to create shared artistic spaces and make a meeting point between traditional arts.

Book your seat to see the beauty of the meeting in performing arts, melodies and art pieces.

The event includes:

An exceptional theatrical performance

A joint show telling the story of the meeting of the arts through an artistic partnership between the Royal Institute and the School of Performing Arts at the Korea National University of Arts. The show begins with the story of the Saudi and Korean performers meeting, then presents 5 Saudi performing arts and 5 Korean performing arts, so that the meeting takes place and cultural and artistic knowledge deepens, ending with a joint performing art set to melodies combining the two cultures, offering a complete emotional art experience.

An accompanying art exhibition

The exhibition shows the fusion of traditional Saudi and Korean arts in art pieces across various crafts, such as metalwork, pottery and textiles. All the works on display tell the story of the meeting of the Saudi and Korean artist.

77523768.b:
A variety of experiences celebrating citrus fruits, their high value and their many benefits. We welcome our guests to take part in cooking programmes with international chefs, shop for soap bars and local products made from fruit, taste refreshing citrus juices from the bounty of the lush oasis, and enjoy many other activities suitable for all family members.

Every year the people of AlUla and their guests gather for the joy and delight of the Citrus Festival, celebrating the high value and many benefits of this bounty picked from two hundred thousand trees in the lush oasis. The events last four days in January, from noon until late, and welcome all family members to open markets to shop for more than 30 varieties of local citrus such as oranges, grapefruit, lemons and limes, as well as soap bars with fragrant scents, essential oils, and many other souvenirs made from these fruits. We invite you to friendly competitions where farmers compete in a sporting spirit over the quality of their crops, and live shows in which professional chefs show off preparing the tastiest local and international dishes using different kinds of citrus. Don't miss the chance to taste refreshing, vitamin-rich juices made from the finest seasonal fruit at stalls along the route.

77625835.t: Nancy Ajram Concert at Maraya Hall
77625835.s: Lovers of contemporary song have a date with a long-awaited night performed by the world-famous artist Nancy Ajram with her refined voice at the stunning Maraya hall at the start of the new year.
77625835.b:
Lovers of contemporary song have a date with a long-awaited night performed by the world-famous artist Nancy Ajram with her refined voice at the stunning Maraya hall at the start of the new year.

Nancy continues to spread joy among Arabs with her words and melodies loved by hearts in the third decade of her successful career, with sales of her albums and singles exceeding 30 million copies worldwide. The artist is proud of a long archive of awards and honours she has earned from the most important artistic bodies in the Arab world.

In addition to her great musical success, the "Queen of Arab Pop" has used her wide fame to serve important social causes, especially supporting children deprived of their rights, and her remarkable charitable achievements are reflected in her selection as the first Middle East and North Africa ambassador of UNICEF.

Don't miss the chance to hear "El Donia Helwa", "Enta Eh", "Ya Banat" and many other songs with which we have always painted our best memories and which have accompanied us in our best moments.

77710265.b:
The Behind the Door exhibition.

The exhibition opens its doors to get to know Najdi doors up close and the secrets of their making and sustainability, where visitors will see the skill of Najdi craftsmen and their innate ability to use everything their environment offered to design and decorate Najdi doors with a high artistic sense. Following in the footsteps of the old Najdi door makers and honouring their artistic sense and creative skills, the Behind the Doors exhibition presents a collection of contemporary engineering and artistic works that drew the principles of sustainability, innovation and simplicity from the old Najdi craftsman.

Visit us at the Behind the Door exhibition in the At-Turaif Gardens to learn how the Najdi door and its details have, over time, become one of the most important cultural symbols representing the history and arts of Diriyah.

77750590.t: NEOM Announces the Futuristic Luxury Destination "Aquellum", Designed Among the Mountains
77750590.s: NEOM, Saudi Arabia, 10 January 2024: The NEOM Board announced "Aquellum", its newest luxury destination nestled among the mountains, which will form a community inspired by a futuristic lifestyle, with residential and hotel units and varied facilities, offering a range of experiences supported by innovative architectural designs in line with the latest technologies and finest engineering concepts.
77750590.b:
NEOM, Saudi Arabia, 10 January 2024: The NEOM Board announced "Aquellum", its newest luxury destination nestled among the mountains, which will form a community inspired by a futuristic lifestyle, with residential and hotel units and varied facilities, offering a range of experiences supported by innovative architectural designs in line with the latest technologies and finest engineering concepts.

Aquellum is located on the coast of the Gulf of Aqaba, inside a stunning surrounding mountain range 450 metres high. The destination is a living system that integrates with the surrounding natural environment, designed to drive innovation in design and construction inspired by authenticity and science fiction, away from traditional methods.

Aquellum can be reached through an exceptional journey that begins at the world's first floating marina, where guests will set off on a boat dedicated to entering the destination through an underground waterway, providing an amazing experience as they discover this community.

Visitors will enjoy a distinctive vertical transfer 100 metres high, taking them from the waterway to the complex through a wonderful garden. This digital community will create exceptional vibrant connectivity through the seamless blending and harmony of hotel accommodation, apartments, shops, entertainment and leisure areas, and innovation centres.

A lively street full of life runs through Aquellum across a spacious garden, linking varied community spaces, world-class hospitality facilities, immersive art shows, varied events, shopping outlets and restaurants. The destination also hosts "The Generator", a distinctive space providing inventors, innovators and creative thinkers with one-of-a-kind research labs, which will form a platform for reimagining the future.

Aquellum will have a multi-directional internal transport system that makes it easy to reach the upper floors, takes residents and visitors to their homes and hotels, and lifts them to rooftop gardens with stunning coastal views.

In line with NEOM's commitment to preserving nature, Aquellum will be developed and completed in an innovative and sustainable way that harmonises with its coastal location. The announcement of this destination follows recent announcements of Leja, Epicon, Sirana, Utamo and Norlana, which are also sustainable tourism destinations on NEOM's Gulf of Aqaba coast.

78120846.s: The Yanbu Flowers Festival offers visitors special events and experiences at its venue in Yanbu Industrial City.
78120846.b:
The Yanbu Flowers Festival offers visitors special events and experiences at its venue in Yanbu Industrial City.

For more: https://t.co/R06kigHTr3 pic.twitter.com/9DExZcaNd4

— Madinah Region Emirate (@imarat_almadina) February 18, 2024

Welcome to the 2024 Flowers and Gardens Festival in Yanbu Industrial City! Enjoy a celebration that combines tradition and innovation, giving visitors the chance to enjoy a special educational and entertaining environmental experience. The festival programme offers a large number of new events marked by variety, inclusiveness and offering everything useful and distinctive. The festival presents a unique mix of artistic, cultural and entertainment experiences and events celebrating the rich fabric of art, culture and entertainment amid the vibrant natural beauty of Yanbu. Our festival is not just a gathering but an educational and cultural hub, showcasing varied programmes and exhibitions focused on gardening practices, sustainability and environmental awareness. Join us as we plant knowledge, nurture creativity, and celebrate the beauty of nature.

79152741.b:
The Diriyah seasonal market is a traditional market and an important legacy of the area. The historic Souq Al Mawsim brought together local and regional traders to trade in the heart of Diriyah, and today the Diriyah Gate Development Authority is reviving the market's heritage in the second edition of the Souq Al Mawsim project, which brings sellers, craftspeople and farmers together on one platform, with varied accompanying events to enrich the market visitor's experience. The market aims to:

Highlight the heritage of Souq Al Mawsim and its impact on the economic development of the First Saudi State.

Engage local visitors in a varied experience through social, agricultural, charitable, economic and intellectual exchange.

Support craft trade at the local and regional level in Diriyah.

Raise awareness of the sustainability of Diriyah's farms and craft heritage.

Introduce Souq Al Mawsim as one of the most important cultural heritage markets in the region.

— AlUla Moments (@AlUlaMoments) October 24, 2024

The splendour of winter

The Winter at Tantora festival brings together the elements that make up the region's identity, from history, culture and the arts to creative efforts in music and hospitality, in a stunning seasonal celebration that embodies the spirit of local authenticity. The festival is named after the traditional Tantora in the heart of the old town, the sundial that the people of AlUla used for hundreds of years to mark the start of the winter planting season. It offers a series of interactive experiences designed to enrich guests' knowledge of the heritage of AlUla and the north-west of the Arabian Peninsula.

People from around the world gather in the old town to enjoy the festive atmosphere and be amazed by the beauty of local culture, with a variety of concerts, guided tours, parades, cultural shows, hospitality experiences and many other entertainment and cultural activities.

83938057.b:
The distinguished composer, whose artistic career spans more than 40 years, comes to present his most important works and share the indelible mark he has left on the world of music. From his beginnings and rise to stardom, his fame spread far and wide after a piece he composed for the famous film "The Night of Fatima's Arrest," which won wide acclaim, captivating audiences by blending classical melodies with contemporary music.

Since then, the great composer has continued to impress everyone with his beautiful compositions, producing film scores for many famous films and television dramas. Khairat's exceptional talent extends beyond the screen: he has also composed many ballet pieces that have shone in prestigious theatres and venues around the world.

In a cultural scene where words have long dominated musical experiences, the great composer Omar Khairat has redefined the concert through his live performances and unmatched skill, with a deep background in many genres such as jazz, pop, rock and oriental music, making him one of the most influential composers of the modern era.

Don't miss this chance to experience the timeless music of Omar Khairat live at the Ithra Theatre.

85916570.s: The second edition of the show "Encounter - CONEXÃO" offers an exceptional artistic experience organised by the Royal Institute for Traditional Arts (Wirth), hosting the country of Brazil to create shared artistic spaces and a meeting point between the traditional arts of Saudi Arabia and Brazil. 89874538.b:
The Southwest Cowboy Town is an exciting and innovative project that aims to create an event inspired by traditional American cowboy culture. The town features a distinctive classic design that reflects the atmosphere of the old American West, to keep pace with local and global consumer tastes and diversify tourism products in line with the aspirations of Vision 2030.

The idea of creating a cowboy town includes several key elements:

1. Urban design:

The town aims to emulate classic Western architecture, using the colours and the wooden and metal details that distinguish this style. The town includes buildings such as shops, restaurants and service facilities.

2. Entertainment activities:

We offer a variety of entertainment activities that suit cowboy culture and provide safe, varied fun, such as horse riding, archery, children's houses, Western dancing, horse shows, and old-style sports competitions, as well as live theatre shows at the Cowboy Theatre.

3. Dining and shopping:

The town has a selection of restaurants serving traditional Western food such as grilled steaks. It also has shops selling gifts, clothing and accessories that reflect cowboy culture.

4. Events:

There is a range of events such as live shows, drama and competitions that carry the identity of the town.
89874538.a: Sirr ad Ghalidh, Abha, Asir Region

We invite you to discover the magic of Plateau and enjoy an unforgettable experience that combines fun, culture and authentic Saudi hospitality, in an enchanting atmosphere and mild weather that reflect the beauty and nature of the region.

The project is under the patronage of the Asir Development Authority and is designed to be a seasonal destination offering a unique experience for visitors.

Plateau is a one-of-a-kind tourism and entertainment project and an ideal destination for the Saudi family. It stands in the highlands of Asir in the south of the Kingdom and respects the culture of privacy in the southern region.

Facilities at the project include international and local restaurants, cafes, bazaars, private seating areas, retail kiosks, and an events square offering programmes for families and children that help strengthen family bonds. There is also parking for 300 public and 40 private spaces to meet visitors' needs comfortably and easily.

Al Muftaha neighbourhood is one of the most prominent heritage landmarks in the heart of Abha, and a captivating summer destination that combines the scent of the past with the spirit of the present. Al Muftaha is distinguished by its adjoining mud architecture, designed in the traditional Asiri style, with distinctive colours and patterns that echo the spirit of local culture and tell the region's history with a unique visual beauty.

In summer, Al Muftaha comes alive, with art exhibitions and cultural activities held in its old corridors and the place filled with movement and colour. Visitors move between art exhibitions and handicrafts in an experience that enriches the senses and introduces them to the cultural depth of Asir.

The neighbourhood is also home to a group of restaurants and cafes serving food in an open square overlooking enchanting heritage details, helped along by Abha's mild breezes.

Al Muftaha is not just a place but a complete summer journey into the heart of heritage and art, giving visitors moments of beauty, inspiration and renewal in an authentic and welcoming atmosphere.

Athr Gallery is one of the main pillars of the creative scene in Saudi Arabia, aiming to support the various forms of contemporary art in the region by hosting the finest innovative works by local artists, both seasoned and emerging. The event opens as part of the AlUla Arts Festival 2025 and hosts the exhibition "Echoes of Time" by the artists Dania Al Saleh and Suzan Kariman.

This exceptional artistic experience aims to link the past and the present by highlighting how everyday and historical discoveries affect our understanding of existence, and shape the stories and narratives that bring together historical heritage and contemporary reality. The event is organised between the ancient archaeological sites of Tayma and AlUla, and welcomes art lovers to view the desert from a new perspective that goes beyond its significance as a cradle of historical treasures, highlighting its role as a meeting point between present and past in innovative and varied ways.

The Little Ones Festival at Ithra is a celebration pulsing with creativity, learning and culture, designed especially for young minds, to inspire children of all ages and engage them through an immersive range of activities, shows and workshops.

Children can explore interactive art stations, take part in storytelling sessions, and enjoy shows that encourage learning through play. This year comes under the theme "What if?", aimed at curious minds, where children see the world through a lens of limitless curiosity and every question becomes an invitation to explore.

"What if?" is an immersive festival that aims to spark children's thinking and encourage them to explore, create and ask questions about the world around them. By fostering imaginative play and artistic expression, encouraging curiosity-led exploration, blending art and science through play, and empowering children as creative storytellers, "What if?" nurtures the innovators, dreamers and changemakers of the future.

It is a space where children are not just spectators but active participants in shaping stories, building new realities and embracing the joy of the unknown. At its core, it is an invitation for children and adults to see the world not only as it is, but as it could be!

Get ready for an unforgettable festive experience at Hail Fest, where we bring you a summer full of excitement and suspense, packed with unforgettable shows.

This lively festival offers a wide range of events designed to suit all interests, including the Singing Tent zone, where you can enjoy concerts by some of the biggest artists in Saudi Arabia; the Cowboy zone, designed to offer an entertainment experience inspired by the American West; the shopping zone; and the children's zone, set aside for endless family fun.

You will also have the chance to watch amazing shows that break Guinness World Records right before your eyes.

Don't miss the best summer experience: gather your family, friends or loved ones and celebrate the magic of the Hail Festival 2025!

Festival zones

Singing Tent zone

Enjoy concerts by some of the biggest artists in Saudi Arabia.

Cowboy zone

Designed to offer an entertainment experience inspired by the American West, it includes a stables and horses area with horsemen, photography activities, and an environment decorated with hay bales. There is also a cinematic photo corner with backdrops inspired by the cities of the Old West.

Dining zone

Get ready for an unforgettable culinary journey in the dining zone! Here, we bring you the most famous and delicious foods from around the world under one roof. From authentic local flavours to innovative international dishes, you will find something to satisfy every taste and your passion for food. Come and taste unique experiences, because every bite here tells a story!

Shopping zone

Set out on a unique shopping adventure in the shopping zone, where elegance meets creativity! Here you will find a wide range of carefully selected products, from the latest fashion trends and modern accessories to unique souvenirs and finely made handmade products. Whether you are looking for a special piece for yourself or an unforgettable gift for your loved ones, our zone guarantees an enjoyable shopping experience full of discoveries.

Come and enjoy every moment of shopping, because every corner hides something new for you!

Children's zone

Let your little ones set off on unforgettable adventures in the children's zone! We designed this space especially to fill their day with joy and safe play.

From interactive games to fun activities that develop their skills, your children will find a whole world of fun and laughter.

Let them make wonderful memories while you enjoy peace of mind!

Artisans' zone

Immerse yourself in a world of art and creativity in the artisans' zone! Here, you will see with your own eyes how simple materials are turned into stunning works of art by real creators. From long-established traditional crafts to innovative contemporary designs, every piece tells a story of passion and skill. Come and engage with the artists, and perhaps you will find a unique work of art to decorate your home or give as an unforgettable gift!

The festival serves 15 dishes daily of authentic popular foods, alongside distinctive folklore performances and cultural experiences such as henna art, making pink garlands, and a bazaar selling southern handicrafts. It also has a lane set aside for farmers to display and sell their fresh local produce.

Why visit the Asiri Food Festival?

An authentic experience from the heart of the south:

Over 30 days, enjoy the rich flavours of Asir and experience the details of authentic southern cuisine in a heritage and family atmosphere amid Asir's stunning nature.

Taste, interact and take part:

From traditional foods to interactive cooking workshops, take part in varied experiences such as baking bread in a tannour oven, making areeka and aseeda, and learn the secrets of cooking from local and international chefs.

A journey from farm to table:

Discover the farmers' lane filled with local seasonal fruit, and experience country life from milking cows to grinding grain and making bread.

91220236.t: Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition 2025
91220236.s: The largest exhibition of its kind in the Kingdom and the world, bringing together everything related to the heritage of falconry and hunting and overland trip activities in a cultural and entertainment event.
91220236.b:
The largest exhibition of its kind in the Kingdom and the world, bringing together everything related to the heritage of falconry and hunting and overland trip activities in a cultural and entertainment event.

The exhibition aims to provide the best and largest selection of falcons and hunting tools and supplies in the Kingdom, in addition to firearms and air guns for hunting and personal weapons. It also targets visitors from all segments of society through accompanying activities and events offered for all family members, as well as visitors interested in falconry, hunting and overland trips.

The exhibition works to raise visitors' awareness of the hobby of falconry and hunting and to pass on its rich heritage to current and future generations, as one of the Kingdom's main cultural heritages. It also includes a platform for displaying and selling hunting weapons, where Saudi companies represent more than 55 international brands specialising in weapons and ammunition for hunting.

94514056.t: Prince Mohammed bin Salman International Calligraphy Center Museum (Dar Al Qalam)
94514056.b:
About the event

Here, you will follow the chapters of the story of Arabic calligraphy across the Islamic world, from its earliest beginnings to its most recent expressive forms. Arabic calligraphy is a wonderful artistic expression whose colours cross the boundaries of time and place. For centuries, the Arabic letter has travelled across the world, carrying the knowledge of a nation and bringing its sciences and culture to the whole world. Within its folds the verses of the Holy Quran were preserved, the first of which revealed was a command from God, the Almighty, to His servants to read, and in which the pen was honoured as a symbol of knowledge and learning. Madinah was the beacon from which the light of Arabic calligraphy shone and its radiance spread until it covered every corner of the earth.

Get ready for a global event awaited by entertainment and adventure lovers! On 31 December 2025, Six Flags Qiddiya City opens its doors to become the largest theme park in Saudi Arabia and one of the most prominent entertainment destinations in the world, covering more than 320,000 square metres on the slopes of the stunning Tuwaiq Mountains near the capital, Riyadh. The park will take you on an unprecedented experience across 6 dazzling entertainment zones:

The Citadel: the heart of the park, with international restaurants and luxury shops.

City of Thrills: home to Falcon's Flight, the longest, fastest and tallest roller coaster in the world, and Sirocco Tower, the tallest free-fall tower.

Discovery Springs: water adventures in a stunning desert setting.

Steam Town: thrilling industrial experiences and the unique Iron Rattler roller coaster.

Valley of Fortune: treasure-hunting adventures among ancient ruins.

Future Falconer for children, the Shalayel Museum, the world of taxidermy, four-wheel-drive experiences, archery and air-gun and virtual shooting, sea fishing, hiking, safaris, camel and horse riding, the muqannas (hunting) experience, the falcon auction, folklore shows, and specialised workshops.
